text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why didn't I check more carefully...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! I'm such a silly dum-dum!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd known there was a sale<n>on... I could've
stocked up on<n>Toughness bars!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After failing to keep up to date with<n>the latest sales,
Ines Fujin falls into a<n>funk.
